Some people said that AI is here is going to be the end of software.
有人说，AI 的到来将意味着软件的终结。
It's going to be end of tools company.
也将意味着工具公司的终结。
It's exactly the opposite.
事实恰恰相反。
AI is here, there'll be more users of
AI 已经到来，使用这些工具的人会更多，
these tools that we created over time than ever before.
比以往任何时候都多。
Every single tools company will now become an AI company.
现在每一家工具公司都将成为 AI 公司。
There'll be an agents company,
将会出现代理公司，
not only where they offer tools,
它们不仅提供工具，
but they'll offer you specially optimized agents
还会为你提供专门优化的代理，
that are incredibly good at using their tools.
这些代理非常擅长使用它们的工具。
Canes and CrowdStrike and the so Iqvius,
Canes、CrowdStrike 和 Iqvius，
and just about every enterprise company out there are all building agents,
以及几乎所有企业公司都在构建代理，
and we're just delighted to be working with them.
我们很高兴能与它们合作。
Building agents is not that hard.
构建代理并没有那么难。
It's got five components.
它由五个组件组成。
It's got the model, the harness.
包括模型和 harness。
Both of them have closed and open versions,
这两者都有闭源和开放版本，
but the open shell secure runtime,
还有开放式 shell 和安全运行时，
and then most importantly,
然后最重要的是，
the knowledge and tools and those knowledge and tools belong to you.
知识和工具，而这些知识和工具属于你。
That's your expertise.
那就是你的专业知识。
